title: Sources for the previous snapshot
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine with Boolean tape alphabet, let $\ell$ be a finite list of bit sources, and let $T,t$ be natural numbers. The sources for the snapshot at time $t$ form a list of length equal to the snapshot width: if $t=0$, every entry is the constant false bit; otherwise, entry $j$ is bit $j$ of the block computed by the instruction for the snapshot at time $t-1$.
hypotheses_covered: Finite Turing machine $M$ with Boolean tape alphabet
caveat: The payload does not define snapshot width or the instruction-indexing function, so those construction details cannot be expanded further.
